endpoints.name: Changesets
endpoints.description: The source-control commits linked to one project, with the revision, author, message and the tickets each references. Requires a project id. The bridge between issues and code, where a repository is connected.

endpoints.name: Changeset
endpoints.description: One changeset by revision. Requires the project id.

endpoints.name: Projects
endpoints.description: The projects in the account, each with name, description, open and closed ticket counts, and its default assignee and milestone. The container everything else belongs to; every other endpoint needs a project id.

endpoints.name: Project
endpoints.description: One project by id, with its counts and settings.

endpoints.name: Initial Project State
endpoints.description: A blank project template returned for building a creation form. Form scaffolding, not data.

endpoints.name: Tickets
endpoints.description: The issues in one project, with title, state, the assigned user, the milestone, tags, and the created and updated times. Requires a project id. The central table. Note STATE IS FREE TEXT rather than a fixed enum in Lighthouse -- projects define their own state names -- so state values are account-specific and cannot be assumed to be open and closed.

endpoints.name: Ticket
endpoints.description: One ticket by number, with its full body and comment history. Requires the project id. Note the ticket NUMBER is the per-project one shown in the interface, not a global id.

endpoints.name: Ticket Bins
endpoints.description: The saved ticket queries of one project -- Lighthouse's name for saved filters -- each with its query and current ticket count. Requires a project id. The counts are pre-computed, so a bin answers 'how many are in this state' without paging tickets, and the query text records how the team defines that state.

endpoints.name: Ticket Bin
endpoints.description: One ticket bin by id, with its query.

endpoints.name: Milestones
endpoints.description: The milestones of one project, with title, due date, and the counts of open and closed tickets. Requires a project id. The counts make release-readiness answerable without walking the tickets.

endpoints.name: Messages
endpoints.description: The discussion threads of one project, separate from tickets. Requires a project id. Where design and planning conversation lives when it is not attached to an issue.

endpoints.name: Message
endpoints.description: One message by id, with its replies.

endpoints.name: User
endpoints.description: One user by id, with name and job description.

endpoints.name: Current User
endpoints.description: The account the credentials belong to, with its memberships. One record, always the caller.

endpoints.name: Memberships
endpoints.description: The projects one user belongs to, with their role. Requires a user id.

endpoints.name: Project Memberships
endpoints.description: The users on one project, with their roles. Requires a project id. The access list.

endpoints.name: Token
endpoints.description: The details of one API token, including which user and project it is scoped to. Requires the token. Security metadata rather than project data.
